item.text:
The dashboard now prerenders its heading and section shaped loading placeholders. The API fetch runs inside a Suspense boundary, so it no longer holds up the initial shell. Route loading uses the same placeholders, and partial prefetching is enabled.

`npm run build` passes and reports `/` as partially prerendered. The generated HTML contains the heading and placeholders. Live data still depends on the app’s existing `api.example.com` endpoint.
